page_info.description: Comprehensive list of active and past partnerships with various organizations

mous.organization: Universidad de Tarapacá (UTA) – Arica, Chile
mous.scope: The selected scope of cooperation includes research, education, and training in areas of mutual interest, particularly in Science, Engineering, Economics and Humanities. Specific activities include: o Research collaborations and joint projects. o Exchange of researchers, postgraduates, and postdocs o Research assistantships for Master's and Ph.D. students o Sharing of scientific publications and technical resources Joint workshops, conferences, and seminars.

mous.organization: INESC TEC, Institute for Systems and Computer Engineering, Technology and Science, Portugal (INESC TEC)
mous.scope: Article 1: General Purpose 1. INESC TEC and NIT Goa establish a formal affiliation for collaborative academic, research, and cultural exchange programs. 2. Areas of collaboration include: o Marine Science and Technology integrated with various engineering and scientific disciplines. o Joint research and innovation projects, focusing on Ocean Exploration and Blue Economy. o Defining lab resources at NIT Goa with INESC TEC's support. o International projects and researcher/student exchanges. o Sharing documentation, research materials, publications, and strategies for intellectual property and start-ups. o Hosting joint academic events, workshops, and conferences. Article 2: Specific Targets 1. Explore postgraduate education programs in Ocean Technologies, positioning Goa as a center of excellence. 2. Facilitate student stays in Portugal for research, with joint supervision of post-graduate theses. 3. Promote the CEMENT initiative for multidisciplinary cooperation between engineering and marine sciences.

mous.organization: ASSOCIAÇÃO BIOPOLIS, PORTUGAL
mous.scope: Clause 1: Purpose 1. Establishes a formal affiliation between NIT Goa and BIOPOLIS. 2. Aims to enhance the relationship through collaborative academic, research, and cultural exchange programs. 3. Promotes mutual cooperation in areas of interest and benefit. Clause 2: Actions 1. Joint research in Science, Technology, Biodiversity, Genetics, Evolution, etc. 2. Collaborative R&D and innovation projects in areas like climate change and environmental monitoring. 3. Cooperation in international projects. 4. Exchange of students and researchers. 5. Hosting joint academic and cultural events. 6. Promotion of sustainable technologies. 7. Sharing intellectual property strategies, promoting startups. 8. Mutual exchange of information, advice, and assistance. 9. Other mutually beneficial collaborations. Clause 3: Specific Actions 1. Expand the Coastal Temperature and Biodiversity Observation Network to Indo-Pacific regions, with Goa as a strategic location.

mous.organization: Brest National School of Engineering, France
mous.scope: • Activities such as collaborative research, lectures, symposium. • Exchange of information and materials in fields of interest to both parties. • Exchange of scholars, researchers and staff. • Sponsorship of cooperative seminars, workshops, and academic meetings • Exchange of students ( including undergraduate & graduate) • Other activities as agreed by both parties.

mous.organization: Brest National School of Engineering, France
mous.scope: • The number of outgoing exchange students from each institution is limited to two (2) per year. • The period of study at the host institution is limited to one (1) year. • The home institution will select the appropriate students to attend the host institution. Final acceptance is ratified by the host institution • The status of the student at the host institution will be a non- degree exchange student. • The exchange student must possess a sufficient level of linguistic ability to attend the course at the host Institution. • Upon completion of courses, the host institutions will provide the exchange students with an academic record of completed courses, which the exchange student may use to obtain credits at home institutions, subject to the rules & regulations of the home institution. • The exchange student will pay the tuition and other fees of the home institution and will not be charged an entrance examination fees, submission fee or tuition fee by the institution. • The exchange student will be individually responsible for all other expenses including travel, accommodation, health insurance, etc.

mous.organization: IIT Madras
mous.scope: Scope • Academic and research collaboration • Exchange of academic information, materials, and publications • Exchange of students and faculty • Sponsorship of cooperative seminars, workshops, and academic meetings Student Exchange • Top 10% of NIT Goa students can apply for direct PhD at IIT Madras • Students can pursue 7th and 8th semesters at IIT Madras • Credits earned will be transferred to NIT Goa for B.Tech degree Research Collaboration • Joint research activities in disciplines of mutual interest • Faculty from both institutions will collaborate in supervision of exchange students and joint research Admission to Direct PhD • Top 10% of NIT Goa students with minimum CGPA of 8.0 can apply • Students must complete comprehensive viva within 3 semesters of joining direct PhD program Operational Aspects • IIT Madras will select eligible students for direct PhD program • IIT Madras will select students for summer fellowship and direct PhD program • Students will pay tuition fees to NIT Goa during 7th and 8th semesters at IIT Madras

mous.organization: IIT Hyderabad
mous.scope: Scope • Academic and research collaboration • Exchange of academic information, materials, and publications • Exchange of students and faculty • Sponsorship of cooperative seminars, workshops, and academic meetings Student Exchange • Generally top 10% of NIT Goa students can apply to spend 7th and 8th semesters at IIT Hyderabad • No admission or tuition fees will be charged, but students will pay hostel, mess, insurance, and other applicable charges Research Collaboration • Joint research activities in disciplines of mutual interest • Faculty from both institutions will collaborate in supervision of exchange students and joint research Admission to Direct PhD • Generally top 10% of NIT Goa students with CGPA 8.0 (must) and higher can apply • Students will spend 7th and 8th semesters at IIT Hyderabad and be evaluated for selection to PhD program Operational Aspects • IIT Hyderabad will select eligible students for direct PhD program • IIT Hyderabad will select students for 7th and 8th semesters and PhD program • Students will pay tuition fees to NIT Goa during 7th and 8th semesters at IIT Hyderabad

mous.organization: Airport Authority of India
mous.scope: [A] Aim To create interest in Civil Aviation among students by: • Supplementing theoretical knowledge with practical operations / working • Giving exposure to students in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) / non-STEM domains • Giving opportunity to work on small-duration projects related to Civil Aviation [B] INTERNSHIP PROGRAM: Shall refer to the working arrangement between both the parties, as agreed, i.e.: i.Being part of project implementation at Airport (Observe implementation & Learn) ii. 2-5 days Familiarization (Visits / Workshops) iii. 4-20 weeks Internship [C] APPLICABILITY: The educational institutions in the vicinity of AAI Airports (25-40 km radius), can sign the MoU for their students undergoing Graduation / Post-Graduation / Professional degree courses. [D] DURATION OF MoU: The term of this Memorandum shall be for a period of 5 years from the date of its signing, and may be renewed by mutual consent of both the parties.

mous.organization: University Paris XIII named University Sorbonne Paris Nord – USPN
mous.scope: Scope of the cooperation The partners will identify the areas of common interest and will define the projects they wish to develop together, in conformity with the law in force in each of the countries and within the limits determined by the Agreement. These may include the following activities: a) The exchange of administrative staff, of professors and researchers. b) The exchange of students. c) The development of joint training programs. d) The development of common research projects. e) The common direction of PhDs and dissertations. f) The writing of shared academic articles This collaboration can be extended to other areas by simple amendment.

mous.organization: TELECOMMUNICATIONS CONSULTANTS INDIA LIMITED
mous.scope: Objectives of MoU's: 1. To build competencies and engagement in 5G technologies in students and academic fraternity. 2. To enable projects at under-graduation and postgraduate level for students using the 5G environment. 3. To encourage academia-industry engagement to ideate and develop 5G use cases. 4. To provide local access to 5G test setup for Startups and MSMEs around the institution. 5. Making Indian academia & startup ecosystem 6G ready. PURPOSE OF AGREEMENT: 1. In line with the budget announcement with an objective to build competencies and engagement in 5G technologies for students & startup communities, DoT is setting up one hundred 5G Use case labs at Higher Educational Institutions across all States/Union territories to facilitate the development, experimentation of 5G applications in various socioeconomic verticals. 2. The use cases could span across socioeconomic verticals including education, agriculture, health, manufacturing, transportation, etc.

mous.organization: National Institute of Entrepreneurship and small business development (NIESBUD)
mous.scope: 1. Training Programs: NIESBUD specializes in providing entrepreneurship training programs and support initiatives for entrepreneurs. NIT GOA can contribute to these programs by sharing their expertise in business incubation, mentoring, and supporting startups. Collaboratively, both institutes can design comprehensive training programs that address both the theoretical and practical aspects of entrepreneurship. 2. Knowledge and Resource Sharing: NIESBUD and NIT GOA can collaborate to share their knowledge, research, and resources related to entrepreneurship and small business development. This can include sharing case studies, research findings, best practices, and success stories to enhance the learning experience for entrepreneurs and aspiring business owners. 3. Inclusive Entrepreneurship Collaboration: NIT Goa has a successful track record of teaching, research, consultancy, etc., providing them with the necessary infrastructure, mentorship, and networking opportunities. Collaborating with NIESBUD expands the reach of such support to a wider audience, including entrepreneurs from diverse backgrounds.

mous.organization: Goa Institute of Public Administration & Rural Development (GIPARD)
mous.scope: This collaboration would enable GIPARD: (a)to conduct a number of training programmes thereby trying to achieve the targets as mandated in the State Training Policy of Goa. (b)to cater to the training programmes for the Elected Representatives at the block levels and district levels. (c)Joint Holding of Conference / Seminar / Workshop / Training /Symposia. (d)Academic Collaboration (e)Exchange of Knowledge Resource Sharing The parties agree to cooperate in the following areas of activity: (a)to conduct training programmes allotted by GIPARD. (b)to provide faculty support in conducting the programmes at their premises. (c)to collaborate in research activities wherever the need arises. (d)to provide their infrastructure to conduct the training programmes, workshops, seminars, symposiums, etc. (e)to promote collaborative academic exchange through faculty, students, lectures and publications. (f)to provide funding for pilot projects by GIPARD related to good governance.
